expected_items.description: Interpret the user's both-sides-are-right request as a durable human judgment arbitration structure.
expected_items.rationale: The request was summarized and planned as a Human Arbitration governance agent.

expected_items.description: Run web-first research and save a public search record.

expected_items.description: Persist the rule that irreducible judgment calls go to human arbitration.

expected_items.description: Connect the arbitration packet to the human decision inbox and non-blocking work policy.
expected_items.rationale: The agent spec references the inbox and records blocked_work, unblocked_work, and resume_action.

acceptance_checks.description: Confirm the new agent appears in the registry list.
Run full repository validation before close-out.
evidence: workspace index and task board regenerated
acceptance_checks.rationale: Full verification completed with exit code 0 after regenerating stale maps and boards.

known_omission_risks: No runtime arbitration engine or UI panel was implemented because the request is currently satisfied by durable governance structure and an inspectable agent spec.
notes: The agent complements human-decision-inbox, principle-guardian-agent, and spec-reconciliation-agent rather than replacing them.
